posts.zh:
dsh-mobile-pwa 已收录到 DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store。基于 dsh-mobile-gate 的完整移动端 PWA：安全远程访问网关 + 可安装到主屏（manifest + service worker）+ 离线可用 + 触屏手势（下拉刷新/边缘返弹/捏合缩放字体）+ agent 完成推送 + 触屏优先布局，桌面零影响。

查看来源与安装：https://deeplugin.store/plugins/deeplugin-7e5d9b3e2ff6cd660af8.html
posts.en:
dsh-mobile-pwa is now listed on the DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store. Complete mobile PWA for DSH, built on dsh-mobile-gate: secure remote-access gateway plus install-to-homescreen (manifest + service worker), offline capability, touch gestures (pull-to-refresh, edge-swipe back, pinch-zoom font), agent-done push notifications, and touch-first layout — desktop unaffected.

Source and install details: https://deeplugin.store/plugins/deeplugin-7e5d9b3e2ff6cd660af8.html
